summary.index: {{count}} settings sections. Read one with get and a section; terminal and budget are app-wide unless you pass project.
summary.get: {{section}} settings of {{scope}}: {{count}} values with where each comes from.
summary.env_scan: Found {{count}} environment variable names the repository uses; {{missing}} are not passed to runs yet.
summary.env_status: {{count}} configured environment names; {{notReady}} are not available to runs.
risk.guardrail_off: Runs started while a guardrail is off are not protected by it.
risk.subagents_on: Agents may start sub-agents, which spend on their own.
risk.env_files_on: Agents in every run can read the project's .env files.
risk.env_inherit: Agents receive the whole Desktop environment, secrets included.
risk.mcp_server: Mission agents will start this MCP server program.
risk.threshold_change: It changes when agents must ask you before spending.
risk.cap_raise: Allows up to {{usd}} USD more spending.
risk.cap_removed: Removes a cap, so spending is no longer limited by it.
error.no_values: Pass the fields to change in values for {{section}}.
error.guardrails_unsupported: The installed Core has no configurable guardrails. Update Core first.
risk.mcp_tier_on: MCP clients can then make these calls without the app open; the person must say yes in this client’s own dialog.
error.tier_raise: Turning on {{keys}} needs the person’s yes in this client’s own confirmation dialog (a confirm token is not enough, and in-app agents cannot do it). If this client shows no dialog, the person turns it on in Specrails Settings ▸ MCP.
risk.commands_run: These commands run on this machine at every verification.
risk.connector_on: Mission agents can use this connector again.
risk.user_mcp_on: Explore turns will start with your own MCP servers and their access.
risk.jira_post: Clarifications will be posted to the project's Jira issues.
risk.browser_url: The terminal's browser shortcut will open this address.
error.gui_only: {{key}} changes only in the Specrails window: {{reason}}
gui_only.local_ui: it is kept in the window's own storage, which the server cannot reach.
gui_only.mcp_enabled: it is the MCP server this client talks through.
gui_only.mcp_connect: it edits another app's configuration file; use Settings ▸ MCP ▸ Connect or specrails-desktop mcp connect.
gui_only.mcp_token: it is the secret this client signs in with; a new one closes the open sessions.
gui_only.pairing: pairing needs a QR code scanned between the two devices.
